owner_calls.question: The series tells/shows (Storm's and Xavier's backstory) that Farouk was a Cairo crook who ran a ring of child pickpockets, young Storm among them, before Xavier beat him. The screen gives the ring no name. Should the record note this past group, and under what name?
options: Leave groups empty (an unnamed ring of child thieves, not a named group)
Add a past group stage, e.g. ["Farouk's thieves", "(from the start)"], named as the owner chooses
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Animated wiki: 'Shadow King was once a slender crook. He used children, such as Storm, to pick-pocket people' (Cairo flashback, Xavier Remembers / Whatever It Takes); Marvel Database: 'former crime boss who used orphans like Storm to do his dirty work', occupation 'leader of criminal gang'. No on-screen name for the gang.
